summary: Implements the widget as a single-file web component (status-widget.js) plus an npm package (@example-org/status-widget). Polls the configured endpoint every 60s using fetch + AbortController and re-renders in place.

self_reported_checklist.note: setInterval(60000) with visibility-change pause to avoid background polling.
README documents the script-tag embed; npm package publish is staged but not yet published, so the npm embed instructions describe a local install only.
No analytics or font CDNs; system font stack only.
